doc: A checkbox allows users to make a single selection or indicate a binary choice. Checkboxes enable users to interact with options within an interface. They can be toggled individually for specific selections or grouped together to allow multiple choices. Additionally, checkboxes can serve as triggers for related actions or display additional information based on user selection.
